title: Saturated signed-correlation cluster extremizer
objective: Prove or refute that a C001 extremizer must saturate a signed-correlation statistic on some nontrivial subset, enabling the module decomposition from route B.
acceptance_checks: Does not use the refuted orbit-concavity or Hessian-averaging step.
Handles high-rank elliptope extreme points outside the cut polytope.
Separates existence of an extremizer from its proposed saturation property.
If saturation holds, derives the cross-block rank-one profile explicitly.
